data.name: Reservations
data.goal: The caller has a confirmed table, or knows exactly why one isn't available.
data.when: The caller wants to book, change or cancel a table.

steps.text: Ask for party size, date and time
If they're booking a new table, check availability

or.text: If they're changing a booking, update it
If they're cancelling, cancel the booking

steps.text: Confirm the booking details and the name on the reservation

never.text: Never confirm a booking for more than 8 guests; {{staff_transfer}} confirms those
